verification_questions.question: Does the rumor journal no longer evict never-applied entries after an interrupted catch-up of more than 1000 rumors (age-only bound or equivalent), with storage still bounded — failing test before the fix?

Is the debounced pending member-removal set durable across an unload (persisted and resumed at startup, or flushed on pagehide), idempotent on replay, and does a unit test show a reload inside the debounce still removes the departed member?

Are stored group member avatars (and contact-cache avatars) re-validated with the shared avatar validator on read or by a one-time sanitise, so an unsafe stored URL is never rendered, with the rest of the profile kept?

Each change minimal, failure-injected at every storage step it touches (a failed persist must not lose the removal; a failed sanitise must not drop the profile), no new user-visible behaviour, docs updated where behaviour statements change?
Unit suite + tsc green; Stryker (concurrency 1) on the touched code has no real-gap survivors; full e2e gate green?
